Name: SF Grampleton Fields Warp
Author: lamplight12347
Description:
[b]This is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039?tab=about+me]Peaceful End

[/url]﻿Update: [/b]1.1 makes very minor edits to code to remove SMAPI message

Adds an obelisk to the game based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11000]CP - Sign Obelisks[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45972757?tab=about+me]Narianka[/url] because I think the style is beautiful. The obelisk warps players to the entrance to Grampleton Fields, which [b]is not included in this mod and must be downloaded in the optional files of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=files]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][/b]

The obelisk is purchasable from the Wizard for:
[i]500,000 (same as water and earth obelisks)
10 clay
30 hay
5 Iridium bars[/i]

The obelisk/sign is seasonal so the grass changes with each season (including winter).
The grass is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolor[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406?tab=about+me]DaisyNiko[/url] as, again, I think it's pretty

At the request of Phytonite I have added an optional vanilla version of the mod with original artwork. [b]However [/b]this version does not have seasonal variety to better fit with the base game.

PS This obelisk is not needed to achieve perfection

If either of the authors above want me to take down this mod please message me.
For any bugs (besides the screen flashing because I'm not worried about fixing that) please comment.
